mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 74 degrees and an air quality reading of 51, which is in the moderate range.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest for Verona students is in full swing. While entries are now closed, the community will be able to vote for their favorite designs from grades K through 12 starting July 28 through August 7. Also, please remember to check your mailboxes and prepare for winter by reviewing the city's mailbox damage policy.

We have a packed weekend starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Reviewing this week's report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a 36-year-old man was arrested for O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
You are in for a treat today with the OREO Cookie Overload flavor. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM for you to enjoy a scoop.
